The ideal candidate demonstrates a proactive, dynamic, and ownership-driven mindset, with strong systemic and strategic vision, the ability to anticipate risks, and proven experience navigating complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Required Experience & Qualifications Proven experience as a Senior Project Manager in complex enterprise IT environments. Strong background managing projects within Oracle ecosystems (Oracle EBS ERP and related solutions) and legacy systems. Solid experience leading large-scale improvements, regulatory compliance initiatives, system upgrades, and testing programs. Demonstrated ability to manage complex stakeholder landscapes and executive-level communication. Strong understanding of end-to-end systems integration and dependency management. Experience in environments with high regulatory and operational complexity. Excellent leadership, negotiation, and problem-solving skills. Key Responsibilities Lead end-to-end project management for complex initiatives involving Oracle platforms and legacy systems. Manage projects related to system improvements, regulatory adaptations (e.G., Tax Reform), upgrades, updates, testing cycles, and new functionality rollouts. Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders, IT teams, vendors, and executive leadership. Drive governance, planning, execution, monitoring, and control of multiple initiatives simultaneously. Anticipate risks, issues, and dependencies, proactively proposing mitigation strategies and corrective actions. Ensure alignment between business objectives, regulatory requirements, and technology solutions. Coordinate cross-functional and multicultural teams, including internal teams, subcontractors, and partners. Oversee scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk management. Deliver clear, concise project communication, status reports, executive presentations, and decision papers. Support strategic planning, roadmap definition, and prioritization of initiatives. Ensure compliance with corporate governance, security, quality, and audit requirements. Desired Profile Proactive and dynamic professional with a strong sense of ownership. Strategic mindset with strong systemic vision. Ability to anticipate issues and risks before they materialize. Results-driven, resilient, and adaptable to changing priorities. Strong decision-making capability and accountability. Comfortable operating in ambiguous and high-pressure environments. Contract & Work Model PJ (contractor) model Long-term engagement: 1 year, renewable Primarily remote, with sporadic national travel as needed

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Role Overview Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration. Key Responsibilities Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation) Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes. Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes. Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations. Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools. Automation, Integration & AI Implementation Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.G., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript). Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks. Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software. IT Administration & Security Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365). Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access. Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security. Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl. Required Qualifications & Skills Technical Experience: 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration. Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment. Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures. High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.G., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting. Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows. Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols. Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies: Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity. Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving;
ability to identify theroot causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms. Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution;
capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions. Benefits & Compensation Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Senior Systems Developer | Professional English Mandatory
description: Senior Systems Developer If you are looking for a meaningful career where people work and act with passion, rethink the existing, and always strive to find the best solution — you have come to the right place. We develop future technologies to relentlessly make supply chains better. We are a leader in supply chain software solutions, helping organizations streamline operations, reduce costs, and improve efficiency. You are expected to work both independently and as part of a team to deliver high‑quality, tailored solutions for the supply chain. Responsibilities · Develop and deploy systems focused on the Supply Chain area, specifying programs, defining requirements, and creating system architecture documentation. · Map business processes and rules with the client, translate them into technical documents, and configure/parameterize the system according to the mapped business rules. · Perform a technical leadership role within the project team, ensuring the quality of the developed code. · Provide consulting to clients following the methodology used for implementing the company’s software solutions. Required Qualifications · Bachelor's degree in information technology or related fields. · Experience in T-SQL(SQL Server) or PL/SQL(Oracle) programming queries and stored procedures (minimum of 4 years of experience). · Experience in relational database modeling (SQL Server/Oracle). · Experience with mainstream programming languages such as C#, Python, Java, Typescript. · Experience with REST/SOAP WebServices using XML and JSON. · Minimum of 7 years of experience in the role. · Strong teamwork skills, initiative, versatility, and discipline to meet deadlines and goals. · Availability for domestic and international travel. · Eligible for CLT employment model. · Fluent English.

title: Executive Administrative Assistant
description: About the Role We are looking for a highly organized, proactive Executive Assistant to provide comprehensive administrative support to our executive team. This role is key in ensuring smooth coordination, communication, and operational efficiency across the organization. Key responsibilities Efficiently manage and prioritize executive calendars, schedules, appointments, and travel arrangements. Draft, edit, and prepare professional documents including emails, memos, reports, and presentations. Screen and prioritize incoming communication to ensure timely responses and proper direction. Coordinate and organize meetings, conferences, and events, including all logistics and materials preparation. Take clear and accurate meeting minutes, distribute them, and follow up on action items. Maintain confidential files, records, and databases with high accuracy and discretion. Build positive relationships with internal staff, clients, partners, and key stakeholders. Act as liaison between executives and internal/external parties to ensure effective communication. Support special projects, research, and analysis assigned by the executives. Identify opportunities for process improvement and implement efficient administrative systems. Qualifications and skills Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, or related field (preferred). Proven experience as an Executive Assistant or in a similar administrative role. Trilingual proficiency: Spanish, English, and Portuguese (required). Exceptional organizational, prioritization, and time-management skills. Excellent written and verbal communication abilities. Strong proficiency with productivity tools (Microsoft Office / Teams / Outlook). Research and project management skills. High level of professionalism, confidentiality, and discretion when handling sensitive information. Strong attention to detail and ability to deliver high-quality work within deadlines. Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to build relationships at all levels. Proactive mindset with strong problem‑solving abilities. Flexibility and adaptability to shifting priorities and work demands. Industry/sector knowledge is a plus. About Kerry Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

title: Professor De Inglês Empresarial
description: Descrição da Empresa A COMUNIK IDIOMAS oferece treinamento empresarial e acadêmico online em diversos idiomas, como inglês, alemão, espanhol, francês e português, além de serviços de tradução. Também promovemos workshops corporativos voltados para apresentações, reuniões, negociações, viagens, conferências, elaboração de currículos e preparação para entrevistas e seleções de emprego e/ou acadêmicas como testes de proficiência. title: Full Stack Engineer
description: This would be a fully remote position, CLT model and salary range is 16k-22k BRL/mo. Must-haves 5+ years of experience as a Full-Stack Software Engineer (approximately 70% front end, 30% back end) Strong JavaScript expertise, including ReactJS, Handlebars.Js, and ASP.NET (Visual Studio) for modifying and extending UI components Backend development experience using C#, .NET Core, and Entity Framework, including creating and modifying REST endpoints and extending data models SQL experience across MS SQL, SQLite, and PostgreSQL, including writing queries and stored procedures to extract data Plusses Experience with C++ development Familiarity with Accessibility standards and related processes Day-to-Day You’ll work in a swarm model, focusing on one priority product at a time to deliver measurable ADA/WCAG improvements before moving on to the next. The role is front-end heavy (~70%), involving refactoring and enhancing React, Handlebars, and ASP.NET components to meet accessibility standards. The remaining ~30% is back-end focused, extending models and creating or modifying REST endpoints in .NET Core/C# to support updated UI flows. You’ll partner closely with Product, UX, and Engineering teams, implement from pre-written accessibility requirements, validate outcomes against the VPAT, and document improvements. Collaboration happens through Teams, daily standups, code reviews, proactive risk and blocker management, and tracking progress toward 2026 goals.

title: Desenvolvedor Front
description:

title: Site Reliability Engineering Manager
description:

builds self-service andguardrails. Reliability: Ensures availability, performance, and resilience of data, middleware, and AI services in production;
builds observability, autohealing, and disaster recovery. What You Will Do Lead and grow the team: Manage, mentor, and develop SRE engineers across Provisioning and Reliability. Lead cross-team initiatives: Align roadmaps with Architects and partner teams;
ensure adoption of architecture standards. Run design reviews and architecture signoffs;
surface and mitigate risks and complexity early. Translate standards into guardrails and automation (policyascode, selfservice) for consistent delivery. Apply lightweight RACI and clear escalation paths to resolve tradeoffs quickly. Drive roadmap and execution: Provisioning: Self-service engines, Crossplane/Terraform-based automation, policy-as-code, secured pipelines, access management, backups/restore, Azure AI resource provisioning, and quota management. Reliability: Observability integrations (New Relic, Azure Monitor), performance tuning, autohealing, DR/BCP, resilience testing, failover automation, SLOs, reliability for Azure AI services and messaging platforms (Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus). Establish engineering excellence: Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Crossplane) and CI/CD best practices. Change management with safe deploys and rollback strategies. Incident and problem management with blameless postmortems. Continuous improvement loops measured by DORA/SRE metrics. Champion security and compliance by design: Policy as code, least privilege access, and secrets/identity hygiene. Guardrails in self-service flows;
auditability and evidence collection. Partnership with Security/Compliance for standards and reviews. Partner with the Architects: Codevelop platform architecture and service standards. Define SLIs/SLOs and capacity/reliability patterns for core services. Align roadmaps and run design reviews for high-impact changes. Own delivery outcomes: Navigate competing priorities across a broad platform scope — balancing reactive operational load (incidents, toil, on-call) against proactive platform investment (self-service, automation, resilience) without a clean separation between the two. Make and communicate prioritization decisions under ambiguity, with partial information, across teams that have conflicting urgency. Maintain a defensible, visible backlog that reflects real risk and business impact — not just the loudest stakeholder. Operate a healthy on-call: High-quality playbooks and automation-first troubleshooting (AI-assisted). Actionable alerts with SLO-based paging and noise reduction. Regular resilience testing and post-incident hardening. Initiatives You Will Lead: Self-service provisioning for databases, queues, and caches with golden configurations and policy guardrails. AI-assisted troubleshooting for provisioning and production incidents. Platform wide observability integration for data, middleware, and AI services (New Relic, Azure Monitor). Automated DR runbooks and resilience/chaos testing in production. Performance tuning at service and query layers, including automated tuning workflows. Standardization of provisioning via Terraform/Crossplane for databases, messaging, and AI services. Governance for Azure AI services (quotas, access, safety guardrails) with clear consumption patterns for product teams. Success Metrics Reduced MTTR and incident count, improved SLO attainment for data/middleware services. Improved lead time for change and change failure rate;
increased automation coverage and reduced toil. Faster time to provision and higher first success rate for self-service requests. Measurable improvements in cost efficiency, performance, and capacity predictability. Team health: engagement, growth, hiring velocity, stress levels, and retention. SLO attainment for AI endpoints and messaging services;
reduced alert noise viaimproved observability (New Relic/Azure Monitor). What You Will Bring Proven experience managing SRE/platform/infrastructure teams delivering production-critical services. Deep familiarity with Azure and the team stack: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB;
Redis;
messaging systems such as CloudAMQP/RabbitMQ, Kafka, Event Hubs, and Service Bus. Strong reliability fundamentals: SLOs/SLIs, incident and problem management, capacity, DR/BCP, performance tuning. Solid automation background: IaC (Terraform/Crossplane), CI/CD (Azure DevOps), GitOps, policyascode, secrets and identity, RBAC. Track record of building selfservice platforms and reducing toil. Excellent crossfunctional leadership with product, security, and compliance partners. Experience operating Azure AI services in production (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, AI Search). Observability experience with New Relic, Azure Monitor, and OpenTelemetry. What You’ll Need Advanced skills in English Experience with AI-assisted operations and troubleshooting. Observability expertise (Prometheus/Grafana, New Relic, Azure Monitor, OpenTelemetry). Database performance engineering and query optimization. Experience in regulated environments and security frameworks. FinOps capabilities (cost governance, forecasting, rightsizing, quotas, budgets, chargeback/showback). How We Work Collaboration first with a strong partnership between the Engineering Manager and the Architects. Automation by default;
security and reliability are nonnegotiable. Blameless postmortems, continuous learning, and measurable outcomes. Participation in an equitable on-call rotation with high-quality runbooks and automation. Tech Environment Azure (AKS, managed databases, storage, networking, identity). Azure AI services (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, AI Search). Azure DevOps for CI/CD. CloudAMQP (RabbitMQ). Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB. Caches: Redis. Queues/Brokers: Kafka, Event Hubs, Service Bus. Terraform/Crossplane, GitOps. Observability: New Relic, Azure Monitor, logs, metrics, traces, alerting workflows.
